description: This PHP source file defines the ListViewMerge class, which extends EditViewMerge. It provides functionality for merging list view metadata in a SugarCRM / SuiteCRM module upgrade context, including loading, processing, merging, and saving metadata related to list view layouts.

classes.name: ListViewMerge
classes.description: A class designed to merge list view metadata components by transforming list view metadata into edit view metadata for merging and then back into list view format. It extends EditViewMerge and handles loading, merging, and saving list view related metadata.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads original, new, and custom metadata files and transforms their data structures into a unified format suitable for merging.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Extracts fields from panels, associating each field with its metadata and location info, treating list view panels as simple lists of fields.

methods.name: buildPanels
methods.description: Constructs panel data structure from merged fields, preserving order and prioritizing custom source fields.

methods.name: setPanels
methods.description: Sets the new data panels based on the constructed panels from merged fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Writes the merged list view metadata to a specified file.

methods.name: mergeFields
methods.description: Merges individual field metadata from original, new, and custom sources into a combined structure.

methods.name: mergeField
methods.description: Combines metadata for a single field, considering matches and differences among original, new, and custom variants.
